unit: luma 0-255 (98th pct of the line ROI, drift-compensated)
sampling: captured pictures only (24/30 fps cadence on the 60 fps grid)
note: caption 2 bottom line (2 words) fades (with a soft blur) out first while the middle and top lines are still on (first in, first out); ROI follows the caption drift (-6.2 px/frame); from-value 240 = full white plateau (f1207-f1213), to-value 116 = footage under the line after the fade (f1230-f1237); the middle line follows about 10 frames later and the top line about 20 frames later
